mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 250.1 signals rising inflation expectations, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise rates, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 250.1 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 250.1, or the effect persists without rate hikes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and contraction in supply (INDPRO) signals upward pressure on prices, leading to investor anticipation of inflation and rate hikes, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The co-movement between GDPC1 and INDPRO does not occur or the returns do not turn negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and GDPC1 > 17,000), sustained low federal funds rates amplify discount rate compression, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline in the regime, or the regime conditions do not hold consistently.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in UNRATE above 4.0% signals tight labor markets and potential rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and driving negative 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not turn negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.0%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.8%) signal accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market conditions, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The co-movement between UNRATE and FEDFUNDS does not occur or the returns do not follow the expected positive direction.

mechanism_narrative: In a contractionary supply shock regime (INDPRO < 95 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), investors anticipate eventual supply-side recovery, generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise in the regime, or the regime conditions do not hold consistently.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS rising above 150,000 in monthly) signals robust economic activity, driving positive 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not rise above 150,000 consistently, or 60-day returns do not outperform baseline (p > 0.05).
